OfferPilot

Practice with an AI interviewer, answer follow-up questions, and review a scored report.

Example session

Interviewer
How would you keep an API responsive when a downstream service slows down?
Candidate
I’d put a timeout on the request, limit retries, and use a circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures.
Follow-up
What metrics and thresholds would let you reopen traffic to the downstream service?

Practice and review

Set the context

Choose a role, seniority, company and interview round. Add résumé context if useful.

Work through follow-ups

Continue answering as the interviewer probes design decisions and trade-offs.

Inspect your report

Review question-level feedback and the overall assessment after the session.

Keep your practice history

Revisit saved sessions and export a report as PDF.

Run a live interview

Start the Next.js server and select a model provider in Settings. The setup guide covers the server routes that power questions and feedback.
